comments.author: Hernan
comments.body:
Ya know there are ways to get around those cheap tactics... when you sail into a port in hostile waters note any players (especially low level ones) idling in front of it. Then you when you actually dock at the port, use search to see if there's any red/orange players there. If both of those conditions are met, that could be a multi boxer pirate. You can do one of 3 things when your ready to leave:

1. Use the Tow and log out feature to tow to a nearby port that's at least about 2-3 sailing days away. Watch a movie, anime, whatever until it's done. Takes me about 30 minutes.

2. If your willing to spend NC you can get a Special ship boarding ticket for 1,500 NC that instantly transports you to one of the nations capitals or a port where liners dock at (Calicut, Santo Domingo, Cape Town etc.)

3. If you have trade goods on board that you need to bring with you, undertaking a quest where there's a time limit, or don't want to try the above two, this is what's left: Carry as little money on you as possible, either through bank or cheques, put all your sails, good equipment, anything valuable in your bank vault, quarters storage, captains bag, and binder and just let yourself get plundered. Your still lose but at least the pirate wont get anything good out of you. (This tactic is more effective if you have a high storage skill rank). Sail back to port you were just at and get your stuff back.
